184.canonical: Treat test flakiness as a trust and productivity problem, and diagnose it first by checking external or unavailable resources, dirty shared or application state, timeouts and asynchronous waits, concurrency, and test-order or mystery-guest dependencies.

239.canonical: Depend on roles (interfaces) rather than concrete classes and mock roles, not objects — reserving mocking of concrete classes as a last resort — and prefer composition and dependency injection over getters added only to enable testing.
